newsitem.title: USA: Pa. unemployment rate rises to 5.4 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Pa. unemployment rate rises to 5.4 pct in June.

text.p: Pennsylvania's unemployment rate rose two tenths of a point in June to 5.4 percent, the state's Department of Labor and Industry said.
But the statistics also showed that just under six million people are at work, the second highest seasonally-adjusted count on record.
The Pittsburgh area, meanwhile, continued to have a lower jobless rate than the rest of the state.
June figures showed unemployment rose to 5.1 percent in the region, a one-tenth of a percentage point jump from May's 5.0 percent.
